parts.name: bottle shell

physics.Basic_description: The main cylindrical body of the bottle, rendered in matte pink plastic with a smooth finish.
physics.Functional_description: Contains the liquid product and provides the primary structural volume of the container.
physics.Grasped_description: A parallel jaw gripper would enclose the cylindrical mid-section to lift or stabilize the bottle.
physics.reason: Standard blow-molded plastic bottles are thin-walled shells enclosing air or liquid.

parts.description: The main cylindrical body of the bottle, rendered in matte pink plastic with a smooth finish.
parts.function: Contains the liquid product and provides the primary structural volume of the container.

parts.name: label band

physics.Basic_description: A lighter pink band wrapping around the center of the bottle body, representing a label or sleeve.
physics.Functional_description: Displays branding or product information on the exterior surface.
physics.Grasped_description: Not a primary grasp target; gripping here might cause slippage if the label material is smoother than the body.
physics.reason: Modeled as a thin solid film or layer adhered to the surface.

parts.description: A lighter pink band wrapping around the center of the bottle body, representing a label or sleeve.
parts.function: Displays branding or product information on the exterior surface.

parts.name: neck threads

physics.Basic_description: The threaded neck region at the top of the bottle, colored pink to match the shell.
physics.Functional_description: Engages with the cap or collar threads to seal the container.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and functionally critical to grasp directly; usually avoided to prevent damage.
physics.reason: The neck is a continuation of the hollow bottle shell with reinforced walls for threading.

parts.description: The threaded neck region at the top of the bottle, colored pink to match the shell.
parts.function: Engages with the cap or collar threads to seal the container.

parts.name: collar shell

physics.Basic_description: The yellow-orange ring component situated at the very top, likely part of the closure mechanism.
physics.Functional_description: Acts as a tamper-evident band or structural collar for the cap assembly.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be grasped to unscrew the cap assembly, though small.
physics.reason: Injection molded ring component is a thin-walled cylinder.

parts.description: The yellow-orange ring component situated at the very top, likely part of the closure mechanism.
parts.function: Acts as a tamper-evident band or structural collar for the cap assembly.

parts.name: collar knurl

physics.Basic_description: The textured, ribbed section of the yellow-orange collar designed for grip.
physics.Functional_description: Provides friction for fingers or grippers to rotate the collar/cap.
physics.Grasped_description: Ideal grasp point for rotational manipulation due to high friction texture.
physics.reason: Part of the hollow collar shell structure.

parts.description: The textured, ribbed section of the yellow-orange collar designed for grip.
parts.function: Provides friction for fingers or grippers to rotate the collar/cap.

parts.name: cap disc

physics.Basic_description: The top flat surface of the closure, colored pink in the RGB but mapped to purple index.
physics.Functional_description: Seals the top opening or acts as a flip-top lid surface.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be pressed or pinched from the top to open or secure.
physics.reason: Plastic caps are typically hollow shells or have internal cavities for sealing liners.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
